notes: Adds automatic post views: as soon as a Telegram post actually sends, the panel can now order views for it from one of your Free Service Gateway upstream providers - point it at a drip-feed views service on the provider's side and it delivers gradually on its own (e.g. ~1000 views over about a day). Configure it on Telegram Channel > Settings > 'Automatic post views' - pick the upstream provider and type its service id directly there. Deliberately separate from the Free Service Gateway's public catalog, so it's never reachable through the public free-service API. Requires 'Update database' (adds two tracking columns to telegram_posts).
